verse.verse_1: When the inevitable event takes place,
verse.verse_2: and there can be no denying its happening,
verse.verse_3: some shall be abased and others exalted.
verse.verse_4: When the earth is shaken violently,
verse.verse_5: and the mountains are totally shattered and crumble to pieces
verse.verse_6: and become like scattered dust particles,
verse.verse_7: [on that Day] you shall be divided into three groups.
verse.verse_8: Those on the Right -- how blessed are those on the Right!
verse.verse_9: Those on the Left -- how unlucky are those on the Left!
verse.verse_10: The third to the fore shall be the foremost.
verse.verse_11: They shall be the nearest to God.
verse.verse_12: They will dwell in the Gardens of Bliss:
verse.verse_13: a large group of the early believers,
verse.verse_14: and a lesser number from the later generations.
verse.verse_15: Seated on couches wrought in gold and encrusted with precious stones,
verse.verse_16: reclining on them facing each other;
verse.verse_17: they will be waited on by ageless youths
verse.verse_18: carrying goblets and ewers and cups filled with the purest wine,
verse.verse_20: along with fruits of their choice;
verse.verse_21: and the meat of any bird that they may desire;
verse.verse_22: and fair maidens with large, lustrous eyes
verse.verse_23: like the pearls in their shells:
verse.verse_24: shall be their recompense for their deeds.
verse.verse_25: They will not hear therein any vain or sinful talk,
verse.verse_26: only the words of peace and tranquillity.
verse.verse_27: Those on the Right, how fortunate are those on the Right!
verse.verse_28: They shall recline on high amidst lote trees without thorns
verse.verse_39: a large group of the earlier people
verse.verse_40: and a large group of those of later times.
verse.verse_41: Those on the Left: how unfortunate are those on the Left!
verse.verse_42: They will find themselves in scorching wind and scalding water,
verse.verse_43: and under the shadow of black smoke,
verse.verse_46: and they persisted obstinately in awful sin,
verse.verse_47: and they used to say, "What! After we have died and become dust and bones, shall we indeed be raised up again?
verse.verse_49: Say, "Indeed, the earlier ones and the later ones
verse.verse_50: will indeed be gathered together at a fixed time on an appointed Day.
verse.verse_51: Then you, you misguided ones, who deny the truth,
verse.verse_52: shall eat the fruit of the tree of Zaqqum,
verse.verse_53: and fill your bellies with it,
verse.verse_54: and shall drink boiling water on top of that.
verse.verse_55: You shall drink it as the thirsty camels drink."
verse.verse_56: This shall be their entertainment on the Day of Judgement.
verse.verse_57: We have created you: why then do you not accept the truth?
verse.verse_58: Have you thought about [the semen] that you discharge --
verse.verse_59: did you create it or did We?
verse.verse_60: It is We who have ordained death for all of you; and We cannot be prevented
verse.verse_61: from replacing you by others like yourselves or changing your forms and re-creating you in forms that you know nothing of.
verse.verse_62: You have certainly known the first creation. Why, then, do you not take heed?
verse.verse_63: Have you thought about what crops you plant?
verse.verse_64: Is it you who cause them to grow or do We?
verse.verse_65: If We so pleased, We could turn your harvest into chaff. Then you would start lamenting,
verse.verse_68: Have you considered the water that you drink?
verse.verse_69: Is it you who cause it to descend from the clouds, or do We?
verse.verse_70: If We so pleased, We certainly could make it salty. Why, then, are you not grateful?
verse.verse_71: Have you thought about the fire that you kindle.
verse.verse_72: Did you produce the tree that serves as fuel or do We?
verse.verse_73: We have made it to be a reminder and a benefit for the wayfarers.
verse.verse_74: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Supreme.
verse.verse_75: Nay, I swear by the setting of the stars --
verse.verse_76: and, indeed, that is a most mighty oath, if you only knew --
verse.verse_77: that this is indeed a noble Quran,
verse.verse_79: which none can touch except the purified.
verse.verse_80: It is a revelation sent down from the Lord of the worlds.
verse.verse_81: How can you regard this discourse with disdain?
verse.verse_82: Do you make its denial your means of livelihood?
verse.verse_83: Why, then, when the soul of the dying man reaches the throat,
verse.verse_84: and you are [at that moment] looking on [helplessly] --
verse.verse_85: and We are nearer to him than you, although you cannot see Us --
verse.verse_86: why, then, if you are not subject to Our command,
verse.verse_87: do you not cause the soul to return to him if you are truthful in your claim?
verse.verse_88: But if he [the dying person] is one of those brought near to God,
verse.verse_89: then for him there shall be comfort and plenty and a Garden of Bliss;
verse.verse_90: and if he is of those who are on the Right,
verse.verse_91: he will be greeted with, "Peace be to you," by those on the Right.
verse.verse_92: But if he is one of those who rejected [the truth] and went astray,
verse.verse_93: he will be welcomed with boiling water.
verse.verse_95: This is indeed the indubitable truth.
verse.verse_96: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Supreme.
